## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by adjusting the shotgun scalper parameters to improve performance on J anchor days while maintaining overall profitability. The top keeper from the stage-5 grinder shows promise in J day capture but falls short of the OP-16 edge_capture floor.

## Mechanism

Entry: Triggered when vol_ratio_threshold >= 1.2 and chandelier_arm_pct conditions are met (details proprietary to shotgun scalper logic).  
Exit:  
- Take profit at tp_premium_pct=0.75 (75% gain)  
- Stop loss at stop_premium_pct=-0.35 (35% loss)  
- Time stop at time_stop_min=12 minutes  
- Strike offset: strike_offset=2 (2 strikes OTM)  
- Chandelier arm: chandelier_arm_pct=0.6 (60% of move to arm trailing stop)
